LESSON: READING 6.2.1 READING COMPREHENSION: READING STRATEGIES

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.2: Reading 6.2.1 Reading Comprehension: Reading Strategies

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Reading 6.2.1 Reading Comprehension: Reading Strategies. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How is reading important in acquiring information?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. apply the skimming strategy to identify the main idea in a text for comprehension
2. appreciate the importance of reading for information

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: READING 6.2.1 READING COMPREHENSION: READING STRATEGIES
This lesson teaches Reading 6.2.1 Reading Comprehension: Reading Strategies for Grade 7 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES.

STUDY STEPS
1. apply the skimming strategy to identify the main idea in a text for comprehension
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. appreciate the importance of reading for information
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Reading 6.2.1 Reading Comprehension: Reading Strategies using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Reading 6.2.1 Reading Comprehension: Reading Strategies above.
2. Explain Reading 6.2.1 Reading Comprehension: Reading Strategies to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Reading 6.2.1 Reading Comprehension: Reading Strategies.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading 6.2.1 Reading Comprehension: Reading Strategies with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Reading 6.2.1 Reading Comprehension: Reading Strategies important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How is reading important in acquiring information?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. apply the skimming strategy to identify the main idea in a text for comprehension
2. appreciate the importance of reading for information

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
